action.command:
cd /workspace && sleep 5; curl -sS -m 15 http://localhost:8080/processes 2>/dev/null > /tmp/procs.json; ~/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.13-linux-x86_64-gnu/bin/python3.13 -c "
import json
from collections import Counter
d=json.load(open('/tmp/procs.json'))['data']
c=Counter(p['status'] for p in d)
print('Total:',len(d),'| ',dict(c))
bad=[p for p in d if p['status'] not in ('Running','Completed') or p.get('exit_code') not in (0,)]
print('Not-OK processes:', [(p['name'],p['status'],p['exit_code']) for p in bad])
"; echo "=== containers ==="; docker compose --env-file .env ps --format '{{.Name}} {{.Status}}' 2>/dev/null
